changelog:
# CHANGELOG for firmware release v157 — target esp32c3
## ✨ New Features
* Added support for Matter protocol on ESP32C3 devices
* Implemented Wi-Fi provisioning using esp-idf framework
* Enhanced device discovery for improved connectivity

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fixed issue with repeated device restarts due to Wi-Fi connection loss
* Resolved bug causing incorrect reporting of device battery levels
* Corrected issue with device failing to connect to Matter network

## 🔐 Security
* Identified 1 secret in the codebase, which will be addressed in the next release
* Confirmed 0 critical CVEs affecting the current firmware version
* Security score remains at 0/10, indicating a high priority for improvement

## ⚡ Performance
* Optimized flash usage, currently at 43.9%, with potential saving of 95 KB
* Improved device boot time by reducing unnecessary initialization steps
* Enhanced overall system responsiveness

## 🔍 Code Quality
* Generated 5 new tests to improve code coverage and ensure reliability
* Conducted code review to identify areas for improvement and refactoring
* Implemented coding standards and best practices for future development

## ✅ Quality Gates
* Build process completed successfully with no errors or warnings
* Verified that all quality gates were met before releasing the firmware
* Confirmed that no AI patches were applied in this release

## ⚠️ Known Issues
* Device may experience connectivity issues in certain Wi-Fi environments
* Matter protocol support is still in the experimental phase
* Security score remains a concern and will be addressed in the next release

## 🔜 Next Release
* Prioritize improving security score and addressing identified secrets
* Continue to optimize flash usage and improve overall performance
* Enhance Matter protocol support and device connectivity features
